title: BestConfigHeadRefusal
description: Closed refusal envelope of the content-less agent-head read (GET /api/v1/best-configs/agent-heads/by-ref/{agent_ref}) and of the PROTECTED best-config publish (POST /api/v1/best-configs carrying X-Traigent-Agent-Ref, or made within a content_less_v1 session). Same members as the generic error envelope but closed: `error_code` is one of the codes below, `error` and `message` are the fixed text for that code, and nothing of the request (ref value, ids, environment, generation, headers) is echoed. `reference_not_found` is the Backend's existing identity-ref refusal (an unknown, foreign, malformed or no-longer-visible ref are indistinguishable). A refused protected publish writes no publication row and moves no head. The legacy publish keeps its own bodies (including STALE_HEAD_GENERATION) unchanged.

error.description: Fixed broad error name for the code.

error_code.description: reference_not_found (404): agent_ref unknown, foreign, malformed or not visible. head_capture_invalid (400): the protected publish is missing X-Traigent-Agent-Ref or X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation, one is malformed, the request names a head capture the session binding cannot back, or the session binding cannot be resolved. head_environment_mismatch (409): the publish environment differs from the session's recorded environment. head_agent_mismatch (409): the ref's agent is not the agent the session binding resolves. head_generation_stale (409): the head moved since the capture (re-read the head by ref and re-run the promotion). head_write_unauthorized (403): the caller lacks agent WRITE authorization.

enum: Head capture is missing or malformed.
Environment does not match the session.
Agent does not match the session.
Agent head moved since the capture.
Not authorized to promote this agent.
message.description: Fixed text per code, in the order of error_code.
